intake_analysis.case_summary: Amber Bell and Erik Devlin entered into a contract with LLW Construction, represented by Mike Winiarek, for home renovations. After multiple payments totaling $100,000, they experienced significant issues with the quality and completeness of the work. Despite ongoing communications, the contractor has been unresponsive. They have incurred additional costs and are facing potential liens from subcontractors. The clients seek financial recovery for their losses and compensation for further expenses related to correcting the work.
desired_outcomes: Reimbursement of payments made for incomplete or substandard work (~$100,000)
Compensation for additional costs incurred to correct or complete the work
key_facts: Multiple issues with work quality noted by December 2024.
Legal consultation initiated with Bernhardt Riley.
intake_analysis.financial_impact: Clients have paid $100,000 and face additional costs for repairs and potential liens.
